trazabilidad.alcanceVerificacion: This verification checks the consistency of the traceability chain and detects the alterations identifiable under the chaining mechanism and the security conditions used; if there is a break, it reports where it occurred. In v1/v2 links (keyless SHA-256), a complete rewrite of the chain recalculating every later hash might go undetected; in v3 links (HMAC-SHA256), the protection assumes that the key stays secret. The result is not equivalent to immutability, does not by itself certify the whole history of the data, and is not a health, regulatory or DIGEMID compliance certification on the storage of medicines.
trazabilidad.confirmarAislar: This record will be marked as isolated and excluded from the verifiable chain. The action is audited and cannot be undone.
trazabilidad.desdeAyuda: Required. Without a time, starts at 00:00 that day.

The node keeps them and resends them afterwards; meanwhile, a reading outside 2-8 °C raises an unverified-origin alert.

causasRotacion.compromiso: Compromise (the previous token may have leaked)

causaRotacionAyuda.preventiva: The device keeps reporting while the broker console is updated.
causaRotacionAyuda.compromiso: From the rotation on, the system holds this device's telemetry: whoever has the previous token cannot submit readings. Retention ends when, with the console confirmed, the node proves it holds the new credential; it then resends what it kept.

dispositivos.posesionPendienteAyuda: Console confirmed. Retention ends when the node signs the challenge with the new credential; if the console was not changed, the node cannot do so and retention continues.
dispositivos.reenviarDesafioAyuda: After fixing the password in the console: kicks the node session so it reconnects with the new credential and resends the challenge.
dispositivos.desafioReenviado: Challenge resent: the node will reconnect and must prove the new credential.

metricasIA.descripcion: Review examples of how the model assigns a risk level to each reading.
metricasIA.definicionF1: Summarizes how the model identifies situations and avoids incorrect classifications, considering the number of cases in each group.
metricasIA.avisoDatosNoReportables: Illustrative sample with synthetic data. It is not a validated evaluation and cannot support claims about real classifier performance.
metricasIA.contextoNoVerificado: Data origin and test-set evidence still need confirmation. The threshold is not compared.
metricasIA.contextoUmbral: The prototype criterion is {{umbral}} or higher. This result does not show the refrigerator's current status.
metricasIA.definicionExactitud: Share of evaluated cases the model classified correctly.
metricasIA.definicionDeteccionCritica: Share of actual critical excursion cases identified by the model.
metricasIA.notaEvaluacion: Classifier results on a test set. These are not temperature readings or daily activity from the pharmacy.
metricasIA.porClaseAyuda: Compare how each risk level was classified in the evaluated cases.
metricasIA.definicionesTabla: Precision: of the cases the model assigned to a situation, how many matched. Detection: of the actual cases in that situation, how many it identified. F1 summarizes both measures. Cases evaluated is the count used for each row.
metricasIA.comoSeEvaluoAyuda: The average uses {{folds}} data partitions separated by scenario.
metricasIA.agrupacionAyuda: Each partition groups readings by scenario to compare performance.
metricasIA.particionMuestrasValor: {{entrenamiento}} to train the model · {{prueba}} to evaluate it
metricasIA.variablesAyuda: Importance reported for each variable; these details follow the results.
metricasIA.notaImportancias: The percentage compares importance reported for each variable. It does not, on its own, indicate a cause or the probability of a situation.
metricasIA.notaReproducibilidad: These details help identify the evaluation. A random seed or fingerprint alone does not guarantee that training can be repeated exactly.
metricasIA.notaUsoProfesional: These metrics evaluate a classifier. Follow your pharmacy's procedure when responding to an alert; this result does not replace professional review.
metricasIA.errorCarga: We couldn't load the model results. Try again.
metricasIA.reglaIndependiente: Random Forest classifies Normal or Preventive risk. A critical excursion is confirmed by the independent 2⁠–⁠8 °C rule; it is not a model probability.
metricasIA.dispersionAria: Weighted F1 per fold: {{valores}}. Mean {{promedio}}. Criterion {{umbral}}.
metricasIA.sinClases: This evaluation has no per-class results.

versiones.vacio: No versions are registered. No approved version classifies in production.
versiones.errorCarga: We could not load the model versions.
versiones.confirmarReemplaza: It replaces the active version {{actual}}, which stops classifying.
versiones.confirmarSinActiva: There is no active version right now.
versiones.confirmarTraza: The change is recorded in the audit log and the traceability chain.
versiones.confirmarBloqueo: The system will reject the activation until this is resolved:
versiones.activada: Version {{version}} activated. It is now the only one classifying in production.
versiones.desactivarEfecto: No version will remain active: the preventive model is not loaded and risk is decided again as before any version was activated. Alerts for temperatures outside 2–8 °C do not change.
versiones.desactivarTraza: It is recorded in the audit log and the traceability chain with your user, the date and the reason.
versiones.desactivarMotivoAyuda: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. It is recorded in the traceability chain.
versiones.desactivarMotivoCorto: Enter a reason of at least {{min}} characters.
versiones.desactivada: Version {{version}} deactivated. There is no active version: the preventive model does not classify and risk is decided as before activation.
versiones.desactivarNoActiva: Version {{version}} was not deactivated: it is no longer the active version (someone else may have deactivated it or activated another). The list was refreshed.
versiones.desactivarYaNoActiva: Version {{version}} is no longer active. The system's response did not arrive, but the refreshed list confirms it; the audit log records who deactivated it and why.
versiones.desactivarNoRegistrada: Version {{version}} was not deactivated: it is not registered. The list was refreshed.
versiones.desactivarConflicto: Version {{version}} was not deactivated: the system rejected the change. The list was refreshed.
versiones.desactivarInvalida: The system rejected the reason: it must have between {{min}} and {{max}} characters.
versiones.errorDesactivar: We could not deactivate the version. Try again; your reason is kept.
versiones.rechazadaCriterios: Version {{version}} was not activated: it does not meet the activation requirements. The active version stays in place.
versiones.rechazadaNoRegistrada: Version {{version}} was not activated: it is not registered or approved. The active version stays in place.
versiones.errorActivar: We could not activate the version. Try again.
versiones.sinPermiso: Your role cannot manage model versions.
versiones.registrada: Version {{version}} registered. It is not active yet: activate it once it meets the requirements.
versiones.registradaYActivada: Version {{version}} registered and activated. It is now the only one classifying in production.

form.descripcion: Record the reproducibility metadata of a trained and approved version.
form.huellaAyuda: 64 hexadecimal characters: the sha256 of the deployed model file.
form.huellaInvalida: The fingerprint must have 64 hexadecimal characters.
form.fechaRequerida: Enter the training date and time.
form.horizonteAyuda: Label look-ahead window. Without H the version cannot be activated.
form.horizonteInvalido: The horizon must be a whole number between 1 and 1440 minutes.
form.metricasAyuda: Object with numeric values of the acceptance criterion. Without them the version cannot be activated.
form.metricasNoNumericas: Metrics: every value must be a number.
form.particionesAyuda: Object with entrenamiento, prueba and separacion_min. Without them the version cannot be activated.
form.particionesInvalidas: Splits: every value must be text, a number or a list of texts.
form.noActiva: Registering does not activate the version. On activation, the system checks the criteria and that the deployed artifact matches the fingerprint.
form.activarAlRegistrar: Mark it as the active production version when registering
form.activarAlRegistrarAyuda: The same requirements as for activation are checked (criteria and that the deployed artifact matches the fingerprint). If they are not met, the version is neither registered nor activated and the rejection is logged.
form.rechazadaAlActivar: The version was neither registered nor activated.
form.rechazadaAlActivarCriterios: Version {{version}} was neither registered nor activated: it does not meet the activation requirements. The active version stays in place.
form.rechazadaAlActivarArtefacto_preventivo: Version {{version}} was neither registered nor activated: the deployed preventive model artifact does not match this version. The active version stays in place.
form.rechazadaAlActivarArtefacto_legado: Version {{version}} was neither registered nor activated: the deployed legacy model artifact does not match this version. The active version stays in place.
form.rechazadaAlActivarArtefacto_desconocido: Version {{version}} was neither registered nor activated: the deployed artifact does not match this version. The active version stays in place.
form.invalida: The system rejected the version data.
form.error: We could not register the version. Try again.

guia.descripcion: What to check, how to respond to an alert, and where to find records.
guia.inicioDescripcion: Start with the refrigerator status. If an alert appears, review the reading and follow your pharmacy's procedure.

monitoreo.descripcion: See the latest reading and device status.

alerta.descripcion: Open Alerts to review its level and when it occurred.

historial.descripcion: Use History to review readings from another time or date.

guia.estadosTitulo: Read the temperature and its status
guia.estadosDescripcion: The status summarizes how a reading compares with the allowed range.

normal.descripcion: The reading is within the range shown for the device.

preventivo.descripcion: The reading is approaching a limit; review it before it leaves the range.
preventivo.fueraDeOperacion: Out of operation in this system: there is no approved, active preventive model. The state is decided by the 2⁠–⁠8 °C rule and no preventive alerts are created.
preventivo.condicional: It only appears when the system has an approved preventive model active; otherwise the state is decided by the 2⁠–⁠8 °C rule.

critico.descripcion: The reading is outside the allowed range. Check the refrigerator and follow your pharmacy's procedure.

sinDatos.descripcion: The device didn't send readings in time. It isn't an excursion: check its connection.

guia.rangoNota: Check the allowed range in Monitoring and compare the reading with its date and time.
guia.alertaTitulo: Review the situation and record what happened
guia.alertaDescripcion: An alert shows a risk level and its related reading. Recording an action documents the response.

revisar.descripcion: Open the alert and check temperature, date, and time.

registrar.descripcion: If your role allows it, mark the alert as acknowledged and note the action taken.

guia.alertaPermisos: Pharmacists acknowledge the alert and record the corrective action; pharmacy technicians view the alert and its timeline. Auditors have read-only access.
guia.ejemplo: 4.3 °C is within range. A reading of 8.4 °C is outside it: review the alert, follow your pharmacy's procedure, and record the response.
guia.pantallasDescripcion: Available links depend on your role.

monitoreo.descripcion: See the latest temperature, device status, and recent readings.

alertas.descripcion: Review notices, their risk level, and when they occurred.

historial.descripcion: Find readings by device, risk level, and date range.

integridad.descripcion: Check for differences in related records; this does not replace official documents.

reportes.descripcion: Review or download a period summary of readings, alerts, and actions.

metricas.descripcion: Review the model evaluation; it does not show current temperatures.

auditoria.descripcion: See which actions were recorded and who performed them.

usuarios.descripcion: Manage staff access and permissions for each role.

dispositivos.descripcion: Review device connection, location, and calibration dates.

estadoServicio.descripcion: Check the database, MQTT, startup, proxy, backups and AI model.

rango.descripcion: Temperature limits configured for checking storage conditions on a device.

preventivo.descripcion: An alert that a reading is approaching a limit, even if it is still within range.

excursion.descripcion: A period when the temperature was outside the allowed range.

integridad.descripcion: A review that can flag later differences in related readings and actions.

bpa.descripcion: Good Storage Practices. The ColdCare checklist supports internal checks but does not certify compliance.

alerta.titulo: Does an alert confirm that medicine was damaged?
alerta.respuesta: No. ColdCare shows readings and refrigerator status; it cannot determine medicine condition on its own. Follow your pharmacy's procedure.

integridad.titulo: Does the integrity check replace official records?
integridad.respuesta: No. It can help flag differences in records, but it does not replace professional review or official documents.

metricas.titulo: Do these metrics show the current temperature?
metricas.respuesta: No. They summarize how a classifier performed on test cases; they do not show current temperatures or alerts.

guia.nota: Available screens depend on your role. Actions that change records also follow your system permissions.

resumenPasos.inicio: Check, respond and keep a record
resumenPasos.estados: Normal, preventive, critical and no data

guia.reglaAria: Reference range from 2 to 8 °C with two examples: 4.3 °C within range and 8.4 °C outside.

rail.telemetriaDetalle: A configuration change does not recalculate or rewrite readings already recorded or their integrity seals.

general.guiaOk: The database and the broker API respond.
general.guiaDegradadoSinMotivo: The server reports a degraded status.

bd.pendientesAyuda: The database is not on the latest migration of the deployed code: the «alembic upgrade head» pre-deploy step did not run.

arranque.descripcion: Command the server process started with.
arranque.ok: Started with {{lanzador}} and 1 worker: a single MQTT consumer.
arranque.ayudaSinBloque: The server does not report the command it started with.
arranque.ayudaSinLanzador: The process did not start with {{lanzador}}: the start command configured on the platform may be a different one.
arranque.ayudaOtroLanzador: The process started with «{{actual}}», not with {{lanzador}}.
arranque.ayudaWorkers: With {{n}} workers there would be {{n}} MQTT consumers processing the same telemetry.
arranque.ayudaSinWorkers: The server did not report how many processes (workers) it has.

proxy.descripcion: What the server sees behind the platform proxy.
proxy.privacidad: The client IP is not shown: it is the public address of whoever is checking.
proxy.ayudaHttp: The server receives requests as http: the proxy does not forward X-Forwarded-Proto or is not among the trusted proxies (FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS).
proxy.ayudaSinXff: The request has no X-Forwarded-For: the server cannot know the client's real IP.
proxy.ayudaIpPrivada: The server sees an internal IP, probably the proxy's rather than the browser's.

notificaciones.descripcion: Queue and delivery of email alerts.

vigilancia.descripcion: Detects devices that stopped sending readings.

respaldos.descripcion: Result of the scheduled database backup.
respaldos.sinVigilancia: The server is not checking the result of the scheduled backup.

alerta.vencido: The scheduled backup is overdue: there is no completed backup within the allowed window.
